# CartWise

> CartWise is a free website that helps US shoppers fight grocery inflation using only real, sourced, dated public data. It never shows sample or invented prices. If a number can't be verified, it's left out.

## Tools and data sources
- Compare stores (organic): 19 organic produce items with real prices from Trader Joe's (traderjoes.com product search, no store selected) and Whole Foods (wholefoodsmarket.com online prices, default ZIP 98101), retrieved 2026-10-12, each with a source link, next to the USDA benchmark. Target and Costco are marked "not published" (checked: no verifiable organic produce prices). Sprouts, Kroger, Walmart, Aldi, Safeway and Publix are "not checked yet".
- Restaurants near you: type a ZIP and pick All, Fast food or Sit-down, with an optional max per person. In Chicago and the western/southwest suburbs (Oak Brook, La Grange, Lemont, Homer Glen, Orland Park, Tinley Park, Downers Grove, Elmhurst, Bridgeview and others), 46 restaurants show real menu prices copied from their own menu pages (retrieved 2026-10-12, source link per place, name and price checked on the page), sorted by a computed typical meal per person (median entrée plus median drink, or entrée only). Other nearby places come from OpenStreetMap (Overpass API; ZIP location via Zippopotam.us) without prices. Other areas show a note that menu prices are coming. No invented prices or ratings. Data: /data/chicago_menus.json
- Gas: type a ZIP and pick a grade (regular, mid-grade, premium, diesel). Shows the AAA average for the ZIP's state, the AAA national average, and the cost of a 15-gallon fill. Sources: https://gasprices.aaa.com/state-gas-price-averages/ and https://gasprices.aaa.com/
- Organic groceries (primary): enter a shopping list. Each matched item shows USDA AMS national weighted-average advertised retail prices for organic produce at major US grocery chains (weekly FVWRETAIL report, National Organic Summary), by variety and package size, with the note "Use this as a benchmark. If your store charges much more than this, look at store brands, Aldi, or Walmart." Items not in the report are left out. Source: https://www.ams.usda.gov/mnreports/fvwretail.pdf
- Tips: unit-price traps, meat and bakery markdown timing, international and bulk aisle swaps, price matching and rain checks, store-brand equivalents, shrinkflation, coupon and cash-back stacking.

## Facts
- Free, no account. Hosted as a static site.
- Each data file in /data has a "retrieved" date and a source URL.
- Not affiliated with USDA, AAA, Kroger, Walmart, or any restaurant chain.
